regularity.S: locally absolutely continuous Hermitian matrix; positive definite at every finite time
regularity.J: time-independent finite n-by-k complex full-column-rank matrix, 1<=k<=n
regularity.c: unique locally absolutely continuous exact finite-model solution of cdot=A c

generator: A=-i solve(S,H)-solve(S,D) in atomic units; replace H by H/hbar otherwise
finite_interval: No uniform infinite-half-line coercivity required; SPD and continuity imply coercivity on each compact interval
tail_extra_assumption: rho belongs to L1([T0,infinity)); physical verification belongs to G04/G05
normalization: N=c(t0)†S(t0)c(t0); use factor N unless N=1 or population divided by N

units.D_A_Sdot_Qdot_W_rho: inverse time with hbar accounted for

scope_exclusions: time-dependent coordinate change without connection and Jdot terms
numerical_test_domain: small well-conditioned synthetic finite matrices; float64/complex128; no B0 native evaluation
